description:
Hire a marketplace agent (requires login).

    Use this after the user has tried an agent and wants to keep using it.
    Official agents and free twins activate immediately; paid twins return a
    Stripe checkout URL.

    Args:
        slug: Agent slug from the marketplace listing.
        api_key: Bearer token for authentication (required).

    Returns:
        {"status": "active"|"pending", "agent_slug": str, "checkout_url"?: str}
name: awareness_hire_agent
